notes: Libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte (1787). Words follow the Schirmer vocal score's spelling and punctuation, which differ from the libretto in places: Anna and Ottavio sing "Il suo dolor" (libretto pallor), Elvira "Restate, oh Dei" (libretto Restate ancor), Elvira "pavento" and Giovanni "tormento" (libretto tormento / spavento), Ottavio "se non so com' è l'affar!", Anna "il suo tratto" (libretto volto), Elvira "si dovria" and "ho perduta", "scelerato" with one l (sung as scellerato), Giovanni "Zitta, zitta" and later "zitto, zitto". The score's repeats are their own phrases. IPA, word meanings and translations were drafted for this app (S18) and the IPA was checked against Castel. IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions (two words on one note in the score) joined with ‿, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ. Translation literal, for meaning.
